title: db: accept xilinx kernel flavor for VCK190 (LP: #2168842)
description:
Accept the xilinx kernel flavor for Xilinx Versal VCK190 (LP: #2168842).

The VCK190 db entry only accepts xilinx-zynqmp, but on noble and later the linux-xilinx-zynqmp meta package pulls the plain xilinx flavor (e.g. 6.8.0-1036-xilinx), so flash-kernel skips the FIT image and boot script install on kernel updates. This widens the match to "xilinx xilinx-zynqmp", matching the Kria entries.

Tested on a VCK190 with the noble server image from xlnx-image-definitions (boots to login with an equivalent /etc/flash-kernel/db override). Test build for noble: ppa:sinan-k/xlnx-flash-kernel.

SRU MPs for resolute and noble will follow once this is approved.
